Keep the complete long rear hair and loose strands, NOT a shortened bob. Keep the original small curved nose. Do not redesign, make a generic circle, smooth the brush texture or lighten the colors.
Only two permitted edits:
1. Remove everything except the complete head/hair: no neck shaft, chest, clothing, arms, hands, legs, feet, paper, leaf, page marks or cast shadow.
2. Remove ONLY the black eyes, eyebrows and mouth strokes/opening, filling those tiny regions seamlessly with the surrounding original warm skin texture and light/shadow. The blank face is intentional: original-source eyes/brows/mouth will be separate animated layers. Keep the nose and the face contour. No dots, ghost facial features or new facial features.
Reconstruct only hair hidden by removed limbs/clothing, following the same existing strands; preserve all visible original detail. Transparent alpha all around every hair strand. No text, labels, grid, other heads or other pieces. Keep generous clear margin on all sides, do not crop the ponytail or hair tips.
